notes: This file is the swappable house-style layer. A future deck skill for another talk forks this JSON and the identity card, keeps the engine (SKILL.md, references 01-07, scripts).

roles.field: ink_navy — header band, footer rail, divider panel, table header, chart ink
roles.marks: ink_ice — band text, logos, footer, page numbers
roles.accent: ink_teal — title ribbon, section eyebrow on body pages, key statements
roles.data: ink_navy + ink_orange only; never introduce a third data colour
roles.text_on_paper: ink_navy (headings) / caption (secondary) — caption must be >= 6:1 on paper

font.rule: one family; weights only, never a second typeface

motifs.halftone_dots: rotated grid, pitch 13-18 px at 1920 wide, radial ramp from a clean centre
motifs.stripes: single 45-degree family, pitch 13, width 2.4 px, no crosshatch
motifs.pattern_tiles: navy tiles with 5-30% paper dots for dark blocks (table headers, divider panels)
motifs.hairline_ring: 1 px registration circle on the disc motifs
motifs.feet: no rules, no corner squares, no 3x3 dot grids — remove leftover marks

media_rules.video: 1280x520 @ 60 fps, 6 s panels, poster = final (state) or mid (action) frame, loop on click
media_rules.charts: native pptx charts only; print-style ink fills; no 3-D, no gradients inside bars
media_rules.logos: ice-ink single-colour versions printed straight on navy, no white plates

animation_rules.entrance: fade + 24-38 EMU/thousand ink rise (text), wipe up (vertical bars), wipe right (horizontal bars)
animation_rules.chart_build: bldSub + a:bldChart (category for 1-series/stacked, series for clustered), one click
animation_rules.click_budget: 43 groups for 21 main pages — do not add click stops when enriching motion

forbidden: a pattFill preset other than the documented list (pct35 corrupts the file)
text below 4.5:1 contrast on its background
adding or removing page numbers / footer on a subset of body pages
